description: National/locality aggregate analytics, fixed classifications, correctly defined historical bloc changes and medians. include_cities adds the UI’s latest-size-selected city matrix; missing results stay null.

election_id.description: latest, a Knesset ID such as k26, or full YYYY-MM-DD date. A bare 2019 is ambiguous.

include_cities.description: Include the city comparison matrix selected by latest-election size when true; default false. Missing historical results remain null.

name: get_analytics
